summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.34.2): ## What's Changed - Added first-run setup when running `ollama`, with options to sign in or continue locally. Setup completion is shared with the desktop app on macOS and Windows. - Added `ollama://apps` to open the desktop app’s Apps page directly on macOS and Windows. - Fixed excessive memory growth during long generations with MLX speculative decoding. - Updated llama.cpp. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.34.1...v0.34.2
